text:
Asha (CSM): Alert: BlueGrove renewal in ~5w. Health dropped amber->red; DAUs down ~52% last 21d. Need a tight save plan.
notify-bot: [ALERT] account=bluegrove drop=52% period=21d renew=2026-05-01 health=RED
Ben (CS Ops): Pulling top feature usage and last 30d error rates now.
Ivy (Onboarding): They never completed webhook validation and only enabled a single team. No SSO.
Asha (CSM): Hypothesis: limited seats + unfinished integration -> low value. Proposed micro-play: 1) 45m "value sprint" workshop to finish webhooks + enable 2 more seats, 2) ship 2 tailored templates + one-pager, 3) offer 1 re-implementation hour + 500 credits conditioned on +15% DAU in 30d, 4) downgrade fallback: prorated Lite bundle with export and 30d re-onboard.
Ravi (AM): OK to offer credits if tied to measurable milestone. Prefer credits over discount.
Ben (CS Ops): Quick SQL I'll post: SELECT feature, count(distinct user_id) FROM events WHERE account_id='bluegrove' AND ts>now()-interval '21 days' GROUP BY feature; will share table in 30m.
Ivy (Onboarding): Draft outreach: "Hi team 60We saw activity dip; can we run a 45m value sprint to finish setup and try 2 ready-made templates? Thurs 3pm or Mon 10am?"
Asha (CSM): Assign: Ivy = schedule + send note, Ben = metrics + triage checklist, Ravi = propose credit amount, Asha = lead workshop and update renewal doc. Reconvene after session. Thanks :thumbsup:
